CLMA No. 6804/2019 ( Delay condonation application in short counter affidavit)
In
WPMS No. 493 of 2019
Hon’ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. Bharat Tiwari, Advocate holding brief 
of Mr. H.C. Pathak, Advocate for the petitioner. 
Mr. M.S. Bisht, Brief Holder for the 
State/respondent nos. 1 to 3. 
Cause shown is sufficient. Delay in filing 
the short counter affidavit on behalf of respondent 
nos. 2 & 3 is condoned. Delay condonation 
application is allowed. Short counter affidavit 
filed on behalf of respondent nos. 2 & 3 is taken 
on record. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner prays for 
and is granted two weeks’ time to file rejoinder 
affidavit. 
List thereafter. 
Interim order to continue till the next date 
of listing. 
 (Alok Singh, J.) 
 22.05.2019 
 Nahid
